definitions.Meaning: Patient identifier; retain the capital P in Patient_num.
Index treatment: Risankizumab, Tofacitinib or Upadacitinib.

definitions.Column: Findings on baseline endoscopy (within 6 months prior to start)
definitions.Meaning: Baseline endoscopy findings within six months before treatment: Mild, Moderate to severe or Normal.
Three-month response: Clinical remission, No response or Partial clinical response.
Twelve-month response, using the same three supplied categories. Separate 12-month frequencies were not supplied.

definitions.Meaning: Severity at the first endoscopy after therapy begins: Mild, Moderate to severe or Normal.

purpose: Index treatment and treatment-start date, baseline endoscopy, clinical response at 3 and 12 months, and post-treatment endoscopy.
